Research Question: Can official DeepSeek Flash produce grounded, complete verified trajectories on the unchanged training20?
Hypothesis: Low API cost can yield useful demonstrations, but reward alone does not establish full-trajectory quality.
Independent Variable: Teacher model/provider and necessary API envelope; no claim of identical provider tokenization or seed behavior.
Metrics: API tariff estimate and CPU cost
Evidence Gate: Full request/response/tool/state evidence; non-thinking enforced; replay equals online state; full quality review before any data admission. No training.
Cost Bound: 20 tasks, at most120 API calls, sequential,1800s,90s/request,no retries; estimated model fee roughly0.42-0.85RMB at prior token volume, planning allowance5RMB (not a hard invoice cap); CPU no-card0.10RMB/h. No GPU.
Failure Branch: Stop immediately on API,infrastructure or contract failure; preserve partial evidence and unknown charges. Keep policy failures; no automatic retry,prompt change,extra sample or SFT.
seed_reproducibility: No undocumented provider seed sent; fixed cohort selection preserved
